description:
Look up a company on SEC EDGAR by ticker, name or CIK. Returns company name, tickers, SIC code, state, and recent filings list.

Examples: company='AAPL', company='Lockheed Martin', cik='0000320193'.

cik.description: 10-digit CIK number (e.g., '0000320193' for Apple). Leading zeros optional.

name: sec_company_search
